title: Display a digit and its decoded state path
description: You connect each test image to a path decoded with its predicted class model.

steps.description: You transpose seq back into image orientation and display it in grayscale. The title includes the supplied true and predicted labels.
You plot the path in a second panel. Its horizontal positions represent image columns, and its vertical values represent states.

steps.question: Does viterbi_path receive the true-label model or predicted-label model?
steps.answer: It receives models[pl], where pl comes from y_pred. The true label is passed to the display separately.

steps.description: You decode and display the selected test examples. The supplied recording contains no rendered figures or text output to assess.
